people.name: Esau_Mount
people.line: Mountainous region of Edom; judgment prophesied by Obadiah

people.name: Teman
people.line: Region and town in Edom, known for wisdom

translations.web: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
translations.bsb: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
translations.kjv: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
translations.asv: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.
